mentions.claim_text: He says he saw in a vision that the president's approval rating will hit twenty five per cent, an all time low, and notes it is at thirty one right now.
mentions.quote: his approval rating will hit at 25%. The all time low ever
mentions.falsify_match: Approval polling reaches twenty five per cent.
mentions.falsify_miss: It stays above thirty. He gives the current figure himself, which makes the gap checkable.

mentions.claim_text: He says he tries to be the cheerleader saying America is going to be okay and will make it, but that he sees a shaking coming.
mentions.quote: America's going to be okay. But I see a shaking
mentions.falsify_match: America comes through the period intact.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Both halves are asserted at once.

mentions.claim_text: He says America will fight through it, that people around the president are making poor decisions and giving bad counsel, and that he is not calling the president stupid.
mentions.quote: Don't give bad counsel. Who told him
mentions.falsify_match: A named adviser is later blamed for a reversal.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such episode.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that they will be successful in the mission, and that the president does not trust Turkey and will not trust Turkey.
mentions.quote: I pray for him that he does not trust Turkey
mentions.falsify_match: An American agreement with Turkey that goes badly.
mentions.falsify_miss: The relationship holds.

mentions.claim_text: He says he loves the nation and prays people do not go off a cliff, and that when he hears certain things he gets a check inside and says oh God.
mentions.quote: I have a check. And instantaneously I just go, Oh, God
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a description of how he receives impressions.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that if the president goes to Turkey he will be protected with angels camped around him, but asks for divine delays so that he does not go, and says do not trust Turkey or Syria.
mentions.quote: I ask for divine delays. That he will not go
mentions.falsify_match: The visit is delayed or cancelled.
mentions.falsify_miss: It goes ahead. Praying both for protection if he goes and for delay so he does not covers both outcomes.

mentions.claim_text: He prays the president go vertical rather than horizontal, keep his eyes on God and humble himself, and that every plot and plan will not stand.
mentions.quote: That he would go vertical with you
mentions.falsify_match: No successful plot against the president.
mentions.falsify_miss: One succeeds.

mentions.claim_text: He says the streets of Seattle will split like Venezuela and that this runs all the way down through San Francisco, with California and Portland named, and a great shaking coming from that area.
mentions.quote: I see the very streets of Seattle splitting like Venezuela
mentions.falsify_match: A Cascadia rupture splitting streets from Seattle to San Francisco.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such rupture.

mentions.claim_text: He says it will be strong enough to set off tremors and set off the land in Yellowstone, and that the epicentre is Vancouver.
mentions.quote: IT WILL SET OFF THE land in Yellowstone. Epicenter is Vancouver
mentions.falsify_match: A Vancouver earthquake followed by Yellowstone activity.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such sequence. There is no established mechanism by which a Cascadia event triggers Yellowstone.

mentions.claim_text: He sings a worship song about the glory of God's presence filling the place.
mentions.quote: Oh, all the glory of your presence
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a sung worship passage.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.

mentions.claim_text: He thanks God for the Clarity Act and the Save America Act, says they push it through, that the lobbying will stop and that a great outpouring of finances will follow.
mentions.quote: the lobbying will stop and we'll have the great outpouring of finances
mentions.falsify_match: Both acts pass and the lobbying subsides.
mentions.falsify_miss: Either fails.

mentions.claim_text: He says a major revival is coming to Venezuela and that they are on the heels of it rather than it being far off, with Colombia and Cuba also having major revivals.
mentions.quote: we're on the heels of it. Colombia will have a major revival
mentions.falsify_match: Recognised revival movements in all three.
mentions.falsify_miss: None emerges. He addresses the objection that he has said this for a long time by tightening the timing.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees Putin again and deals being made, that this is what Turkey has to do, and that Turkey wants Putin to get Zelensky.
mentions.quote: Turkey wants Putin to get Zelensky
mentions.falsify_match: A Turkey brokered arrangement that removes Zelensky.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such arrangement.

mentions.claim_text: He says Israel is in the background but this is bigger, and that he is going to sit down in the Turkey and Putin meeting in the spirit.
mentions.quote: I see Turkey, Putin. I'm going to camp right there in their meeting
mentions.falsify_match: A Turkey and Russia meeting on Ukraine takes place.
mentions.falsify_miss: None does.

mentions.claim_text: He asks repeatedly why he sees the president with a glazed ham covered in flies, given concerning the Muslims, and offers no interpretation.
mentions.quote: A ham that is glazed and it has flies on it
mentions.falsify_match: The image resolves to an identifiable insult or incident involving pork and Muslim partners.
mentions.falsify_miss: It stays uninterpreted, which he acknowledges in the moment.

mentions.claim_text: Speaking partly in tongues he says he sees the meeting and sees Turkey, and that in the distance he sees Macron, adding that he does not know whether he is at the meeting but his influence is there.
mentions.quote: I don't know if he's at the meeting, but his influence is there
mentions.falsify_match: French influence over a Turkey and Russia arrangement.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such influence. He hedges the presence himself.

mentions.claim_text: He says great persecution is coming to the church in America and that they have not seen the beginning of it, that he has seen some very hard things, and that persecution brings forth the greater glory.
mentions.quote: we haven't seen the beginning of persecution that's coming
mentions.falsify_match: Legal or state action against American churches at scale.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs. The greater glory clause makes persecution the proof and its absence no disproof.

mentions.claim_text: Told Turkey met Poland that day, he says the Lord said Turkey would rise up and it would be about Warsaw, and that they will strike Poland in the days ahead.
mentions.quote: Turkey would rise up and it would be about Warsaw, Poland
mentions.falsify_match: A strike on Poland with Turkish involvement.
mentions.falsify_miss: No strike on Poland. A Turkey and Poland meeting is routine NATO business.

mentions.claim_text: He says the vampire is really stretching out today, and that he tried to see what was being said in the meeting but there was not much.
mentions.quote: The vampire is really stretching out today for sure
mentions.falsify_match: Turkish influence expands measurably across Europe.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not.

mentions.claim_text: He says they want war and that he had said the euro is in trouble, and notes the Russian president calling Germany a Nazi Germany, agreeing that it is.
mentions.quote: I said the euro is in trouble
mentions.falsify_match: A euro crisis.
mentions.falsify_miss: The euro holds.

mentions.claim_text: He plays a Russian statement warning that countries allowing their resources to be used for strikes on Russian territory risk armed conflict, and that parties pushing escalation are losing popularity catastrophically.
mentions.quote: Countries who are allowed to use their resources to launch strikes
mentions.falsify_match: Russia strikes a NATO member over weapons transit.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not.

mentions.claim_text: He says he told them Europe would want its own independent armament, that behind the scenes they were being told to stop or be cut off, and now they say they do not need America.
mentions.quote: I said we need our own independent armament. I told you it was coming
mentions.falsify_match: European states build independent defence capacity away from America.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not. European strategic autonomy has been an open policy debate since 2017.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw him acting out ahead and that they would call it a great betrayal, which he says he has now seen in the news headlines.
mentions.quote: they would call it a great um betrayal
mentions.falsify_match: The word betrayal is used in headlines about the transatlantic split.
mentions.falsify_miss: It is not. Betrayal is common headline vocabulary, so this is a low bar.

mentions.claim_text: On reports of businesses refusing service to Israelis in New York, he says he told them antisemitism would come to an all time high in New York and that it is happening.
mentions.quote: I said anti-semitism will come at an all-time high in New York
mentions.falsify_match: Recorded antisemitic incidents in New York reach a documented high.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not. Recorded incidents were already at record levels before this word.

mentions.claim_text: He says Jews will leave and go back to Israel with a named ministry helping fund the return, that he saw them occupying Gaza and it angered people, and that the antisemitism was in Europe and Germany too.
mentions.quote: people like John Hagee's ministry will help fund it to get them home
mentions.falsify_match: An organised funded aliyah wave from America and Europe.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such wave.

mentions.claim_text: He prays over every church against fires, coming against what he calls an arsonist spirit and the people trying to burn churches old and new.
mentions.quote: We come against this arsonist spirit
mentions.falsify_match: Church arson rates fall.
mentions.falsify_miss: They rise. He also claims elsewhere that the fires are coming, so both directions are covered.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees seven on fire, prays over California and over a red wave, and declares voter fraud is being uncovered no matter how much they try to block it.
mentions.quote: I see seven is on fire. Seven
mentions.falsify_match: Seven deliberately set California fires.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such count. The number has risen from four in earlier tellings.

mentions.claim_text: He corrects himself from South Korea to China, saying the Lord said it is further, that there is corruption and ties to China from Minnesota, and that he sees an arrow coming out of Minnesota into China.
mentions.quote: There's corruption and ties to China from Minnesota
mentions.falsify_match: A Minnesota to China corruption case is brought.
mentions.falsify_miss: None is.

mentions.claim_text: He names the former Minnesota governor as connected to China, says a named congresswoman is with it, and hears Google repeatedly.
mentions.quote: It's connected to China. I see Tim Walz
mentions.falsify_match: Named figures are tied to Chinese interests in a documented case.
mentions.falsify_miss: They are not.

mentions.claim_text: He sees fifty gallon black barrel drums with a silver lining at the top concerning the Minnesota figure and China, and calls it a black barrel of toxic material.
mentions.quote: black barrel drums with silver lining at the top
mentions.falsify_match: Toxic material in drums is traced from China to Minnesota.
mentions.falsify_miss: None is. The fifty gallon drum image recurs across unrelated claims in this corpus.

mentions.claim_text: He says Harris is rebranding with a brand new suit and new duds, ties it to the silver lining coming from China in a black barrel with the Minnesota figure, and says that figure is afraid with his face pale.
mentions.quote: Camila Harris is rebranding. A new suit is coming on
mentions.falsify_match: Harris relaunches publicly and the Minnesota figure is implicated in something.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither happens.

mentions.claim_text: He says God is not done with America and that they are about to see the greatest harvest and the greatest manifestations of glory in churches and stadiums, with not enough room to receive it.
mentions.quote: I don't believe that we have room enough to receive all that
mentions.falsify_match: American church attendance exceeds building capacity.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not.

mentions.claim_text: He says he keeps seeing a major move of God in America, in the Latino nations, in Asia and Africa, with a Holy Ghost Woodstock in fields full of people because the coliseums cannot hold them.
mentions.quote: there'll be Woodstock, Holy Ghost Woodstock with fields full of people
mentions.falsify_match: Open air meetings too large for arenas.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such meetings.

mentions.claim_text: He asks prayer for a man he says he saw a covering over, and says he saw a shaking in Brazil and in South America with a great revival and a harvest of souls like they have never seen coming.
mentions.quote: I saw a shaking in Brazil. I saw a shaking in South America
mentions.falsify_match: A major Brazilian earthquake followed by a religious movement.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. Brazil sits in the stable interior of the South American plate and does not produce damaging earthquakes.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is an assignment against the listener's life and their friends, and that Jesus will keep them if they pray and anoint their house, car and plane with oil.
mentions.quote: anoint your house with oil. Anoint your car with oil
mentions.falsify_match: Listeners who follow the instruction are visibly spared.
mentions.falsify_miss: They are not. The condition puts any harm on the hearer's failure to anoint.

mentions.claim_text: He says the more Jesus is preached from the highways and byways the more the nation changes, and that it must be Holy Ghost and fire rather than a watered down religion.
mentions.quote: the more you preach Jesus, the more your nation's going to change
mentions.falsify_match: A national turn following a preaching revival.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such turn.

mentions.claim_text: He notes something has closed but can still be bought, says it was important that they captured it that day, and turns to the secretary of state.
mentions.quote: I just felt that was important that they captured that today
mentions.falsify_match: Nothing to match; a transition.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing to miss; no forward content.

mentions.claim_text: He says to watch what God is about to do in Cuba, that there will be a major revival there with three major churches, wells of churches rising up, and healings and creative miracles taking place.
mentions.quote: There'll be three major churches. I saw wells of churches rising up
mentions.falsify_match: Three prominent churches emerge in Cuba with documented healings.
mentions.falsify_miss: None do.

mentions.claim_text: He restates the briefcase given by Russia in the Cold War, encased in thick lead in a Cuban mountain so that sniffers could not detect it, with American planes flying over trying to find it.
mentions.quote: encased in lead, so that the sniffers could not smell it
mentions.falsify_match: A shielded Soviet era device is found in Cuba.
mentions.falsify_miss: None is found.

mentions.claim_text: He says it was a device from a trade concerning the Cuban Missile Crisis in Kennedy's time, or perhaps the 1980s, and that he keeps trying to pinpoint the period while praying.
mentions.quote: It's a device. It's something around that time frame, maybe '80s
mentions.falsify_match: A device of that provenance is found.
mentions.falsify_miss: None is. He cannot fix the period and says so, spanning two decades.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw men removing things from Cuba to another location because they did not want them left there, and that the longer they wait the more is destroyed and removed.
mentions.quote: I saw these men removing things from Cuba
mentions.falsify_match: Evidence of material being moved out of Cuba ahead of inspection.
mentions.falsify_miss: None emerges. This also pre-explains a null result: if nothing is found, it was removed in time.

mentions.claim_text: He says what he saw can be either symbolic or an actual person the Lord wants prayed for, that many are in distress, and that he believes this one is an actual person.
mentions.quote: it can either be symbolic or it's an actual person
mentions.falsify_match: The person is identified.
mentions.falsify_miss: They are not. The symbolic or literal option is left open, which allows either reading afterwards.

mentions.claim_text: He says Cuba will be a major hub of revival in the days ahead and that a named Miami pastor will lead the charge with major ministries going down to reach the Latino communities.
mentions.quote: Cuba will be a major hub of revival in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: An organised Cuban revival led from Miami.
mentions.falsify_miss: None emerges.

mentions.claim_text: He says the revival will start off good but corruption will come in with money laundering and scandals with money, and that he sees this very clearly though he lives in America.
mentions.quote: corruption to come in with money laundering
mentions.falsify_match: A financial scandal inside the movement he describes.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He calls it the first of the wave and says he is believing for Colombia and Brazil, with a major red wave touching the people of South America and the greatest harvest of souls.
mentions.quote: we're going to see a major red wave touch the people of South America
mentions.falsify_match: Conservative electoral gains and religious growth across South America.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. Red wave is used here for both politics and revival without distinguishing them.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him specifically to pray for churches burning in America, Canada, Toronto and Europe, that they would be old churches, and that he saw the Muslim Brotherhood burning them down, noting a church set on fire.
mentions.quote: I saw the Muslim Brotherhood burning these churches down
mentions.falsify_match: Church arson attributed to Islamist actors.
mentions.falsify_miss: Arson continues from other causes, which is what investigations have generally found.

mentions.claim_text: He tries to identify a speaker he thinks is an Israeli figure born in Iran, and reads that the man said the United States may need another Pearl Harbor or September 11th to remember who the enemy is.
mentions.quote: maybe the US needs another Pearl Harbor or 911
mentions.falsify_match: An attack of that scale follows.
mentions.falsify_miss: None does. The remark is a commentator's, not a plan.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats the Pearl Harbor and September 11th remark, says he does not know the man's name, and says he keeps seeing ground zero.
mentions.quote: I've seen this how many times. I keep seeing ground zero
mentions.falsify_match: A mass casualty attack on American soil.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He describes missiles with a red tip on the nose coming out of an area and going into Moscow, and identifies the weapon shown as a Tomahawk.
mentions.quote: has a red tip on the top of the missile and they're going into Moscow
mentions.falsify_match: Long range missiles strike Moscow.
mentions.falsify_miss: None do.

mentions.claim_text: He says they will use it to blow up the oil refineries and that the cat and mouse will be no more, and that Turkey comes to Russia's aid to block off the Black Sea, beating war drums and becoming like a vampire.
mentions.quote: Turkey coming to the aid of Russia to block off the Black Sea
mentions.falsify_match: Turkey closes the strait in Russia's favour.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Turkey has closed the strait to warships of both sides since 2022 under Montreux, which is the opposite of aiding Russia.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Ukrainian president is doing what the Lord said he would do, going around making the web, and is now holding meetings, turning to Poland.
mentions.quote: He's going around making the web and it's happening
mentions.falsify_match: Zelensky assembles a coalition of European backers.
mentions.falsify_miss: He does not. Diplomatic tours are his standing practice, so this is close to the base rate.

mentions.claim_text: He says he had said they will attack Warsaw in the days ahead and that he sees attacks coming against Warsaw from Russia, and finds it interesting that all this is going on in Poland now.
mentions.quote: I said they'll attack Warsaw in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: A Russian strike on Warsaw.
mentions.falsify_miss: No strike on Warsaw.

mentions.claim_text: He notes strikes on the bridges, says this is not de-escalating, and repeats that he saw a swastika coming up and the Hitler spirit with it.
mentions.quote: See, this thing is not deescalating
mentions.falsify_match: Continued escalation with a far right resurgence in Europe.
mentions.falsify_miss: De-escalation and no such resurgence.

mentions.claim_text: He describes what he feels while praying as the difference between a resting heartbeat at a doctor's office and the pulse of running on a treadmill, no longer a slow beep but a fast one.
mentions.quote: It's not just a beep beep beep anymore
mentions.falsify_match: A visible acceleration of events follows.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing here can fail; a felt sense with no stated referent.

mentions.claim_text: He says fresh Holy Ghost oil started coming from the mouths of the preachers, that the harvest is plentiful and the labourers few, and that he saw a harvest on the preachers of Canada, Toronto and Europe.
mentions.quote: Fresh Holy Ghost oil started to come from the mouth of the preachers
mentions.falsify_match: A preaching movement across Canada and Europe.
mentions.falsify_miss: None emerges.
